# Tracked text files only

GitCollector.collect_full() must return only tracked text files from the repository; in this test run the expected refs are exactly ["README.md", "pkg/mod.py"] and binary files (logo.bin) and untracked files (untracked.txt) are excluded.

Ensure collected artifacts represent the committed textual source files only, excluding binary and untracked files so downstream consumers receive only relevant source artifacts.
